# AIDE

Multi-view driver behavior and emotion data with traffic and vehicle context cues.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Four synchronized views of the driver and driving surroundings.

**Output / label:** Current behavior and context cues; no original intention target is asserted.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/ydk122024/AIDE)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/ydk122024/AIDE)

## Intention in this dataset

Traffic context, driver behavior and pose can support interpretation of driver intention; original annotations describe current states rather than future maneuvers.

**Relevance:** `related` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2023

**Domains:** driver_behavior  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:**   
**Modalities:** rgb, pose  
**Formats:** video, structured_annotation

## Limits and notes

Related cue dataset only; no intention-recognition ranking or future-action protocol is added. The original paper motivates traffic context as evidence for understanding driver intention; no future maneuver labels are introduced.
